name: ER14505

codes.note: As printed on the Tadiran TL-5903 sheet.

dimensions.note: Saft drawing: 14.4 +/-0.2 mm diameter and 50 +/-0.3 mm height. The table lists maximums of 14.62 mm and 50.28 mm for the sleeved cell.

positive.note: Saft drawing: 4.5 mm minimum diameter, 1.5 +/-0.2 mm high.

negative.note: Saft drawing: 7 mm minimum contact diameter.

capacity_mah.conditions: Saft LS 14500: 14 mA, 20 °C, 2.0 V cut-off. Tadiran TL-5903 lists 2.4 Ah nominal

variants.self_discharge: Under 1 percent per year at 20 °C after the first year (Saft)
variants.notes: Tadiran lists 100 mA continuous, 200 mA pulse, 18 g and 0.65 g lithium for the TL-5903. Saft recommends storage at 30 °C maximum.

interchange.note: A 1/2AA Li-SOCl2 battery is the same width and kind but about half the length.

safety: Single-use lithium batteries are not rechargeable; charging, short circuit, crushing, disassembly or heating above 100 °C can cause fire, explosion or venting.
Do not solder directly to the battery; use tabbed or pinned versions.
Lithium thionyl chloride batteries run at 3.6 V; most 1.5 V devices are not designed for that voltage.
notes: Industrial AA-size bobbin cell for long-life, low-drain devices with periodic pulses.

sources.title: Saft LS 14500 primary Li-SOCl2 cell data sheet
